spec_family.name: Exterior Soffit Repaint (Combined Assessment + Prep + Prime + Finish)
spec_family.description: Combined prime + finish repaint spec for previously painted exterior soffit field surfaces on residential homes. Covers condition assessment (visual inspect, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, mildew/algae assessment as soffit-specific priority check, moisture probe on wood panels, caulk condition assessment per 'Think Like a Water Drop', vent condition check for paint clogging), prep remediation (low-pressure wash 500-800 PSI per elevation, mildew/algae biocide treatment as #1 failure mode prevention, chalk remediation for SS_EXT_CHALKING, scrape/feather failing/peeling overhead paint, degloss/scuff sound existing paint, caulk assess/repair at panel joints and trim junctions, vent cleaning, substrate-specific spot scuff on exposed areas), state-driven primer selection (chalk-binding for SS_EXT_CHALKING, acrylic stain-block for SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/PEELING, plus substrate-specific spot primer on exposed bare areas: acrylic on wood, alkali-resistant on fiber cement, bonding on vinyl), standard field finish coat application (brush/roll default, spray conditional on non-vented only), interstage inspection/sanding at QT4, and EPA lead-safe RRP module for pre-1978 homes. SF-based measurement (eave depth x roofline perimeter). Three substrate types: wood T&G/plywood, fiber cement, vinyl. Overhead penalty baked into all base rates.

includes: Condition assessment (visual inspect with work light/raking light, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, mildew/algae assessment as soffit-specific priority check, moisture probe on wood panels at joints and roof penetrations, caulk condition assessment per 'Think Like a Water Drop', vent condition check for paint clogging on vented soffit)
EPA Lead-Safe RRP evaluation and containment for pre-1978 homes (overhead scraping on soffit is HIGH RISK for lead dust exposure — debris falls directly onto crew)
Low-pressure wash (500-800 PSI max, fan tip, mildew-removal detergent) per elevation — NEVER power wash soffit
Mildew/algae biocide treatment (#1 degradation mechanism for sheltered soffit surfaces — painting over mildew = guaranteed adhesion failure)
Chalk remediation pre-treatment for SS_EXT_CHALKING condition before chalk-binding primer
Scrape and feather failing/peeling paint overhead (slowest exterior prep task per SF — gravity works against tool stroke)
Degloss/scuff existing sound paint (chemical deglosser or 150-180 grit mechanical scuff)
Caulk assessment and repair at panel joints and soffit-to-fascia/frieze junctions per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol (this spec's responsibility)
Vent opening cleaning on paint-clogged vents (vented soffit only)
State-driven primer selection and application (chalk-binding for SS_EXT_CHALKING, acrylic stain-block for SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/PEELING, substrate-specific spot primer on exposed bare areas)
Standard field finish coat application — brush/roll default for all vented soffit, spray conditional on non-vented only
Interstage inspection and sanding (QT4 full 220-grit intercoat sand, QT3 spot only)
Glass/fixture masking — soffit-mounted light fixtures (recessed lights, porch fixtures)
Fascia edge masking — MANDATORY in RP (fascia is almost always already finished)
Vent opening masking during brush_roll application to prevent further paint clogging
Landscape/hardscape ground protection — CRITICAL for overhead work (gravity pulls all drips and debris down)
Customer walkthrough with maintenance recommendations (mildew-resistant formulation extends coating life)

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling inspection rigor, interstage sanding discipline, and coat count. QT2 is economy (single coat). QT3 is standard (2 coats). QT4 is premium (2 coats + full intercoat sand).
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT5 excluded — soffit is a utilitarian overhead field surface, not fine-finish millwork. QT2=1.0x (economy baseline). QT3=1.0x (standard baseline). QT4=1.3x (global modifier on qt_scaled tasks).

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique. Brush/roll is default for all soffit types. Spray is conditional on non-vented soffit only.
configuration_dimensions.notes: brush_roll: default, valid for all soffit types (vented and non-vented). spray: CONDITIONAL on vent_type = non_vented. Spray PROHIBITED on vented soffit (FM-003). spray_backroll NOT valid — overhead back-rolling is impractical.

configuration_dimensions.description: Finish coating sheen level. Flat is default/most common soffit sheen.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Flat and satin only. No semi-gloss or gloss — overhead surfaces show imperfections at higher sheen.

configuration_dimensions.description: Exterior substrate state classification driving primer selection and prep intensity.
configuration_dimensions.notes: 4 exterior RP substrate states. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT is the MOST COMMON soffit RP state (sheltered from UV, long coating life). Worst-state-wins per v1.

configuration_dimensions.description: Universal 3-level condition scale driving prep intensity modifier. Maps from substrate state.
configuration_dimensions.notes: GOOD=SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT (1.0x prep). FAIR=SS_EXT_CHALKING or SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT (1.5x prep). POOR=SS_EXT_PEELING (2.0x prep).

configuration_dimensions.description: Soffit substrate material type driving primer chemistry on exposed areas.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Wood: acrylic stain-block primer on exposed areas. Fiber cement: alkali-resistant primer (pH 13.0). Vinyl: bonding primer (mandatory for PVC adhesion).

configuration_dimensions.description: Soffit vent construction type. Gates spray eligibility.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Vented: spray PROHIBITED. Brush/roll only. Non-vented: spray eligible. Physical characteristic of soffit construction.

configuration_dimensions.description: Soffit panel/board construction type. Drives T&G joint complexity modifier.
configuration_dimensions.notes: solid_panel: plywood, fiber cement, vinyl panels. tg_board: tongue-and-groove wood boards. T&G adds 1.20x on brush/roll and sand tasks.

paintable_items.name: Exterior soffit field surface
paintable_items.counting_rules: Net paintable soffit field area: eave depth x roofline perimeter. Deduct vent openings only for material calculation, not for labor. Same physical surface in RP context as NC — horizontal underside eave surface.
paintable_items.notes: Single paintable item. SF-based. Covers all soffit substrate types (wood T&G/plywood, fiber cement, vinyl). No phase suffix needed — single combined spec.

variants.notes: BASELINE. Most common exterior soffit repaint scenario. Sound paint, adhesion verified, degloss/scuff + 2 finish coats, no prime. Brush/roll default.
Economy single-coat soffit RP on sound paint. Minimum viable scope.
Standard RP on chalking or failing paint. State-driven prime + 2 finish coats. 1.5x prep modifier.
Full remediation. Heavy overhead scrape + feather + state-driven prime + 2 finish coats. 2.0x prep modifier.
Premium refresh on sound paint. 220-grit intercoat sand, systematic inspection. No prime.
Premium remediation. State-driven prime + 2 finish coats. 220-grit intercoat sand.
Production spray on non-vented solid panel soffit. Sound paint, cosmetic refresh.
Lead-safe RP. RRP containment + 2.0x prep modifier + state-driven prime + 2 finish coats. Overhead wet scraping.
Economy RP with prime needed. Single finish coat on primed surface.
Full remediation spray on non-vented soffit. Heavy prep + state-driven prime + 2 spray finish coats.

material_systems_summary.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer for Soffit Repaint
material_systems_summary.notes: RP-SPECIFIC. Spot prime on localized failure; full prime on SS_EXT_PEELING. Not used on SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT or SS_EXT_CHALKING.

material_systems_summary.name: Chalk-Binding Primer for Chalking Exterior Soffit
material_systems_summary.notes: RP-SPECIFIC. MANDATORY for SS_EXT_CHALKING regardless of substrate material. Full surface application.

material_systems_summary.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer for Bare Fiber Cement Soffit
material_systems_summary.notes: Reused from NC. Spot prime on exposed bare fiber cement areas (pH 13.0).

material_systems_summary.name: Bonding Primer for Vinyl Soffit
material_systems_summary.notes: Reused from NC. MANDATORY on exposed bare vinyl. Recoat within 1 week.

material_systems_summary.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Soffit Paint
material_systems_summary.notes: Reused from NC. Standard 100% acrylic with mildewcide. Flat/satin only.

material_systems_summary.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic Soffit Paint
material_systems_summary.notes: Reused from NC. Premium acrylic with enhanced mildew resistance. Flat/satin only.

material_systems_summary.name: Solar-Reflective Paint for Vinyl Soffit
material_systems_summary.notes: Reused from NC. CONDITIONAL: vinyl + dark color LRV < 55. HARD STOP — standard dark paint causes thermal distortion.

module_summary.description: Landscape/hardscape ground protection (CRITICAL for overhead), light fixture masking, fascia edge masking (MANDATORY in RP), vent opening masking (vented + brush_roll), equipment setup (brush/spray)
Lead screening, containment setup 10 ft from structure, wet scraping, HEPA vacuum, containment teardown (conditional: pre-1978 + lead). Shared module.
Visual condition inspection, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, mildew/algae assessment (soffit-specific priority), moisture check (wood), caulk condition, vent condition (vented)
Low-pressure wash per elevation, mildew biocide treatment, chalk remediation, scrape/feather overhead, degloss/scuff, caulk repair, vent clean, substrate-specific spot scuff, dust cleanup
State-driven primer brush/roll or spray (chalk-binding or acrylic stain-block) + substrate-specific spot primer (alkali FC, bonding vinyl)
Intercoat inspection, 220-grit sand (QT4 only), touch-up, dust removal. Skipped for QT2 single-coat.
Coat 1 + coat 2: cut-in at fascia/frieze junctions + brush/roll or spray field + T&G brush-back (spray + T&G only)
Final walkthrough inspection, touch-up, vent unmask, protection teardown, equipment clean, site cleanup, customer walkthrough

round_configurations_summary.name: Soffit RP — 2 Finish Coats (No Prime, GOOD Condition)
round_configurations_summary.notes: Most common RP round for soffit (GOOD is the dominant condition due to sheltered location).

round_configurations_summary.name: Soffit RP — 1 Finish Coat (Economy QT2, GOOD Condition)
round_configurations_summary.notes: Economy single-coat RP on sound paint. Minimum viable scope.

round_configurations_summary.name: Soffit RP — State-Driven Prime + 2 Finish Coats (FAIR/POOR Condition)
round_configurations_summary.notes: Standard RP round with condition-driven prime for chalking, failing, or peeling soffit.

round_configurations_summary.name: Soffit RP — State-Driven Prime + 1 Finish Coat (Economy QT2, FAIR/POOR)
round_configurations_summary.notes: Economy RP with prime needed. QT2 single finish coat on primed surface.

stacking_partition.prep_pool: condition_scale x rrp x access x vent x tg (max realistic: FAIR 1.5 x no_RRP 1.0 x ladder 1.35 x vented 1.15 x solid 1.0 = 2.33x)
stacking_partition.coating_pool: quality_tier x access x vent x tg (max: QT4 1.3 x scaffold 1.60 x vented 1.15 x tg_board 1.20 = 2.87x)
stacking_partition.never_cross: Prep pool never includes QT. Coating pool never includes condition_scale or RRP.

protection_zones_required.notes: CRITICAL for overhead RP — gravity pulls all drips and scraping debris straight down. Upgraded to full_cover for spray or when scraping generates debris.
Canvas drop cloths for non-slip crew traffic. Upgraded to full_cover for spray.
Soffit-mounted fixtures — recessed lights, porch fixtures. Bag and tape.
RP: fascia is almost always already finished — masking is MANDATORY. Tape + 12-inch film at fascia-soffit junction.
RP: siding is almost always already finished. Full masking for spray.
RP-SPECIFIC: mask vent openings during brush_roll to prevent further paint clogging.
RP: wider coverage than wall-adjacent protection because overhead debris spreads further.
6-mil poly extending 10 ft from structure — WIDER than wall containment for overhead debris spread.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Fascia board above soffit. SF_TRIM_EXT_RP scope. Caulk at soffit-to-fascia junction is THIS spec's responsibility.
Frieze board at soffit-to-wall junction. SF_TRIM_EXT_RP scope. Caulk at soffit-to-frieze junction is THIS spec's responsibility.
Corner boards at soffit ends. SF_TRIM_EXT_RP scope.
Siding at wall junction below soffit. Protection-only zone for spray.
Porch ceiling when continuous with soffit. Coordinate edge work at transition with future SF_PORCH_CEILING_EXT_RP.

valid_input_states.notes: 4 exterior RP substrate states. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT is the MOST COMMON soffit RP state (sheltered surface). Worst-state-wins per v1.

output_state.notes: All input states normalize to SS_EXT_PAINTED_* after proper prep and coating. Flat is default soffit sheen.

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: RP: fascia is almost always already painted. Masking is MANDATORY.
RP: siding is almost always already finished. Full masking for spray.

site_condition_rules.notes: Soffit is ALWAYS elevated — ground tier applies only to very low eaves. Ladder is the effective baseline for most soffit work. Height modifier stacks ON TOP of overhead-adjusted base rates.
Pre-1978 + lead-positive activates MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT and FAC_SFRP_RRP (2.0x). Overhead scraping is HIGH RISK for lead dust — debris falls directly onto crew.
MC > 15% is STOP WORK for coating on that surface. Active moisture = do not proceed until source resolved.
Mildew is the #1 degradation mechanism for soffit. MUST treat before any coating — painting over mildew = guaranteed adhesion failure.

cross_spec_coordination.deduplication_note: MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT is shared across all exterior RP specs — do not duplicate lead-safe tasks when running alongside SF_TRIM_EXT_RP or SF_SIDING_*_EXT_RP.
cross_spec_coordination.shared_session_note: Exterior soffit RP typically runs alongside SF_TRIM_EXT_RP (covers fascia and frieze). Low-pressure wash ownership per-elevation (U-003): if already done by another spec on same elevation, skip. Landscape/hardscape protection shared (U-004): first spec in elevation sequence owns setup.
coordination_notes: Caulk at soffit-to-fascia and soffit-to-frieze junctions is THIS spec's responsibility (not trim spec).
Low-pressure wash ownership: per-elevation task. Cross-spec deduplication rule U-003.
Landscape/hardscape protection zones shared with SF_TRIM_EXT_RP and SF_SIDING_*_EXT_RP. Protection setup owned by first spec in elevation sequence (U-004).
RRP containment is shared — do not duplicate per-elevation containment tasks.
Height/access modifiers (FAC_EXT_ACCESS) are per-elevation attributes — one building may have different soffit heights on different elevations.
In RP, all adjacent surfaces (fascia, frieze, siding) are almost always already finished — protection is mandatory for BOTH spray and brush_roll methods.
Porch ceiling continuity: when porch ceiling is continuous with soffit (same color), coordinate edge work at transition with future SF_PORCH_CEILING_EXT_RP.

research_corrections.original_claim: RRP modifier is 1.40x on prep tasks
research_corrections.corrected_to: RRP modifier is 2.00x on prep tasks involving paint disturbance. Calibrated per established exterior RP pattern.

research_corrections.original_claim: Environmental conditions (wind, sun, surface temp) should be estimation modifiers
research_corrections.corrected_to: Environmental conditions are NOT estimatable — unpredictable at bid time. Excluded from spec entirely.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup (ground protection + fixture mask + fascia mask + vent mask + equipment) -> RRP containment (if pre-1978) -> Assess (condition/adhesion/mildew/moisture/caulk/vent) -> Prep (low-pressure wash + 24-48h dry + mildew biocide + chalk remediation + scrape/feather + degloss/scuff + scuff exposed substrate + vent clean + dust cleanup) -> Prime (substrate-specific spot prime + state-driven general prime) -> Caulk repair (AFTER prime per COMPAT-SFIT-009) -> Finish 1 (cut-in + brush/roll or spray + T&G brush-back) -> Interstage (inspect + sand QT4 + touch-up + dust) -> Finish 2 (QT3/QT4 only) -> Final inspect + Touch-up -> Vent unmask -> Protection teardown -> Equipment clean -> Site cleanup -> Customer walkthrough
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO power washing soffit (500-800 PSI max). NO spray on vented soffit. NO painting over mildew (biocide treatment mandatory). NO skipping chalk-binding primer on SS_EXT_CHALKING. NO dark paint on vinyl without VinylSafe IR-reflective. NO RRP without containment. NO scraping without feathering. NO caulking before primer. NO bonding primer left >1 week before topcoat.

relationships.notes: First exterior soffit RP spec. Combined assessment + prep + prime + finish. NC exterior soffit is sibling spec with significant task transfer (24 DIRECT + 8 MODIFIED). Context prefix SFRP — no collision with TSK_SFIT_* (NC soffit).
